jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Why you'll LOVE Sagent You could work anywhere. We know you are talented and looking for something inspiring and impactful. A place where you will make a difference and have a great time doing it! By choosing Sagent, you can be part of our mission to make loans and homeownership simpler and safer for all consumers. Sagent powers servicers and consumers. You power Sagent! Overview As a Data Engineer at Sagent, you will help build an entirely new data ecosystem that forms the backbone of our next-generation, event- and API-based financial servicing platform. This platform is being built from the ground up as a cloud-enabled, real-time, data-first solution, and your work will shape how data is collected, moved, stored, and trusted across it. The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineering expert who brings deep knowledge of data integration, migration, and pipeline development on a modern cloud platform. You will collaborate with data analysts, architects, and product and engineering teams to design scalable data solutions that support our mortgage servicing platform and analytics initiatives. Your Day-to-day At Sagent Data Integration and Pipeline Development: Create data collection frameworks for structured and unstructured data. Develop and maintain data integration pipelines (ETL or native cloud pipelines), including data warehousing and online transactional processing (OLTP). Implement ETL pipelines within and outside of a data warehouse using SQL and Python. Develop scripts for loading, extracting, and transforming data. Implement data load strategies to relational databases and cloud data warehouses, and build data integration through distributed data processing pipelines. Handle both batch and streaming data using event streaming and cloud-based big-data processing technologies. Support data movement using microservices (direct ingestion), where applicable. Cloud Data Solutions And Design Serve as a hands-on subject matter expert in data movement, integration, and migration on a modern cloud platform and related technologies. Work with teams to design and implement modern, scalable data solutions using new and emerging cloud technologies. Review internal and external business and product requirements for data operations, and recommend changes and upgrades to systems and storage to accommodate ongoing needs. Design, develop, test, document, and analyze code for features of new or upgraded software systems and products. Develop and execute implementation in accordance with project plans and priorities. Data Analysis And Quality Analyze and organize raw data, build data systems and pipelines, and evaluate business needs and objectives. Interpret trends and patterns, conduct complex data analysis, and report on results. Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability, and identify opportunities for data acquisition. Collaborate with data analysts and architects on a range of projects. Operations, Automation, And Delivery Apply Agile and DevOps techniques and implementation approaches in the delivery of data solutions. Automate and orchestrate data jobs. Test and troubleshoot issues as they arise, monitor and respond to defects, and resolve issues within established SLA timeframes. Manage and approve deployments into QA, UAT, and production environments. Apply expert SQL skills, including performance tuning, when querying relational databases and cloud data warehouses. We would love to hear from you if you have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or relevant discipline with 3 - 4 years of experience in a related field. Experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Hands-on, deep experience working with cloud data products and services for data processing, warehousing, pipeline orchestration, and storage. Working knowledge of distributed data processing frameworks and event streaming technologies. Working knowledge of relational databases and cloud data warehouse platforms. Expert SQL skills, including performance tuning. Capability in implementing cloud data solutions for batch and streaming workloads, along with SQL data analysis and programming interpretation. Excellent spoken and written communication skills. Excellent planning and task-tracking skills. Excellent analysis and assessment of business needs and cross-system impacts. Excellent team-play skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment on multiple projects concurrently. Experience at a mortgage servicer and/or financial technology company. Working to mid-level knowledge of procedural SQL and ETL tools. Experience with microservices-based data ingestion. Perks! As a Sagent Associate, you will be eligible to participate in our benefit programs beginning on Day #1! We offer a comprehensive package including Remote/Hybrid workplace options, Health Benefits, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, Family Planning Services, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Family Leave, 401(k) Matching, Pet Insurance, In-person and Virtual Social Experiences, Career Pathing, Focus Time Fridays and much, much more! Why Sagent? Sagent is transforming the mortgage servicing industry by bringing the modern experience customers now expect from loan originations to loan servicing. Our platform lets customers manage their home-owing lives from anywhere while giving servicers lower costs, scale compliance and higher servicing values through full market cycles. Sagent is a joint venture that combines Fiserv Inc.'s decades of market-leading fintech expertise with Warburg Pincus' skill in growing technology companies. We hire innovators and doers to disrupt the last and most complex frontier of lending and housing. We're growing fast and need you to help shape our future. Sagent is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Macrocosm is building a world model of the global economy, capable of simulating and forecasting the behavior of individual firms across sectors and countries. Our immediate focus is the US electricity sector: modeling generators, transmission networks, large loads, and electricity markets, with the ambition of simulating the entire US electricity system. As our modeling work expands, you’ll also contribute to other sectors of the economy. We're hiring a data engineer to build the data foundation for these simulations. You'll own the path from discovering and understanding complex real-world data sources to building reliable pipelines and defining the datasets our models consume.  This requires more than building pipelines. You'll work closely with modelers to answer questions such as: What does this number actually measure? What information was available at the time of a historical forecast? What should we precompute or cache to make simulations faster? How should we represent a market that operates differently from those we already model? Those answers shape both our data architecture and our understanding of the systems we're simulating. This is a role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering, systems design, and applied research. You'll have ownership over technical decisions, and your work will directly influence what our models can represent, how accurately they can reconstruct the past, and how efficiently they can simulate the future. What we’re looking for Clear communication: you explain decisions and tradeoffs, ask useful questions, and keep teammates informed about progress, uncertainty, and blockers. Experience building data-intensive systems, including pipelines, storage, caching, orchestration, or model execution, with attention to clear interfaces, maintainable code, and practical architectural choices. Good data-modeling judgment around historical changes, revisions, and information availability, alongside hands-on use of AI agents for coding or research with the discipline to verify their output. A collaborative, self-directed working style: you organize your work, seek input when needed, and work with teammates to carry problems from research and design through implementation, debugging, and production. What you’ll do Research and integrate sources . Work with electricity-market reports, grid models, weather forecasts, regulatory filings, trade records, and spreadsheets. Read source documentation, investigate gaps, and turn unfamiliar datasets into dependable inputs. Model the real world in data . Define entities, relationships, grain, keys, and time semantics for assets, firms, networks, and markets. Preserve revisions and provenance so historical simulations use the information available at the time. Design the systems connecting data and models . Define interfaces and responsibilities across ingestion, transformations, storage, data loading, and simulation execution. Make decisions about where computation belongs and how components should fit together. Build systems for large-scale simulations . Work with modelers to improve data throughput, caching, and parallel execution so we can run years of historical backtests, explore more scenarios, and expand our simulations across US electricity markets. Extend our models to more US electricity markets . Research how each grid operator publishes data and runs its markets. Work with modelers to identify what can be reused and where the underlying representation needs to change. Our current stack includes Python, Julia, SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, and GitHub Actions. We're more interested in your ability to reason about systems and learn new tools than in experience with every technology in our stack. Good to have Experience in electricity markets, power systems, commodities, or supply-chain data. Experience working with weather, geospatial, or network data. Forecasting systems, feature engineering, or production machine-learning workflows. Required qualifications Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS or equivalent) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a related field. Strong analytical, quantitative, and critical thinking skills. Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and meet project deadlines. Additional position details Contractor role, with an estimated workload of 40 hours/week Potential to convert to full-time employment based on performance and available funding Fully remote; flexible schedule with a collaborative team environment Competitive hourly rate commensurate with experience

The role combines architecture and engineering, and you will build and prove solutions with the client. Work includes re-engineering legacy data workloads and supporting data migration from MySQL to Databricks Lakebase. Responsibilities Work onsite or embedded with client teams to understand business problems and turn them into working technical solutions. Design and build data pipelines and integrations using Fivetran, Databricks, and AWS services. Lead technical design and delivery for migrating a Tier-1 application from MySQL to Databricks Lakebase, including schema re-design, data migration, cutover, and validation. Integrate SAP data through SAP BTP and BDC Connect, non-SAP data, and design domain centric data products. Build prototypes and reference implementations, then work with the client to harden them for production. Support data and AI use cases, including integration with GCP-based ML/GenAI components. Establish engineering standards: CI/CD, testing, observability, security, and cost control. Coach client and delivery team members, and communicate status, risks, and design decisions to stakeholders. Design end-to-end data solutions across multiple platforms, applying industry standards and best practices to meet client needs. Lead the development of data platform architectures, including cognitive components and unstructured data technologies, annotation, and related data and analytics. Manage and maintain large data repositories, ensuring scalability and performance. Create data solutions on cloud-native platforms (AWS, with GCP for ML/GenAI), tailored to client requirements. Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and deliver customized data solutions that meet their business objectives. This job can be performed from anywhere in the US Required Technical And Professional Expertise Must be able to travel 4 days per week (mandatory). Databricks Certified Data Engineer or Machine Learning Professional. Advanced hands-on expertise in data engineering and solution architecture, with demonstrated ability to design and deliver complex data solutions. Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog), AWS, SQL, and Python, including large-scale batch and streaming workloads. Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, database migration/re-engineering, Fivetran or similar ingestion/ELT technologies, and modern data-sharing patterns. Experience with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and other open table formats, including schema evolution, optimisation, and interoperability across engines. Hands-on experience designing scalable data platforms and pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Amazon EventBridge, or Amazon SQS, along with Terraform and CI/CD practices. Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Experience with Databricks Lakebase or similar managed PostgreSQL/OLTP-on-lakehouse technologies. Knowledge of SAP BTP, BDC Connect, SAP extraction patterns, or SAP IS-U. Exposure to GCP ML/GenAI services and cloud-native solution design across AWS and GCP. Experience with Git-based version control and branching strategies for data workloads. Experience in the utilities or energy industry, with relevant Databricks and/or AWS certification.
